thread:
anya: Quick design check-in — proposing a "compact groups" pattern for the left rail + a tiny "share group" affordance so folks can copy a link to a list (e.g., Models) or to the last-opened item in that group. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-compact-rail (comment-only)

olivia: I like the "share group" idea. For deep links we need a clear contract: permalink should land on the canonical resource URL and set the breadcrumb.

jamal: routing constraints: canonical path examples Id like to lock down:
/app/:wsSlug/models
/app/:wsSlug/models/:modelId
/app/:wsSlug/models/:modelId/versions/:verId
/app/:wsSlug/deployments/:id

We should avoid encoding ephemeral UI state in the path (like "panelOpen").

mike: engineering suggestion: add a minimal server-side redirect table for legacy query URLs (e.g., /models?id=123) -> new path. Also supply a small JSON map from path pattern -> navGroupId for the client nav component so expansion is deterministic on load.

sam: analytics: add page.load_source with values deep_link|nav_click|internal_link. Also emit nav.group_share when someone uses the share button.

ada-a11y: a11y notes: when landing via deep link focus must go to the main H1. If the rail expands, announce the expansion via an aria-live polite region like "Navigation: Models expanded". Share menu must be keyboard accessible and include clear aria-labels.

olivia: copy: breadcrumbs should be human-friendly: "Acme Workspace > Models > T-Rex (v1.2)". Truncate long names to 45 chars with ellipsis and show full name in tooltip and accessible name. Use small chevrons as separators.

anya: one more UX question: should share-group copy the Models list or the last-viewed model? My preference: offer two options in the menu: "Copy Models list link" and "Copy last-viewed model link" (if exists).

mike: that's fine. Implementation: nav component will store lastOpenedPerGroup in localStorage and server-side we can fall back to list link if no last-opened available. We'll avoid storing user-specific state in the canonical URL.

jamal: back-button behavior: opening a share modal or expanding a group shouldn't create a full history entry unless the URL changes. Only significant navigations (path changes, filter queries) should push history.

ada-a11y: QA checklist suggestion: 1) bookmark a nested resource, open in fresh session and verify focus & breadcrumb announcement; 2) tab through share menu; 3) test screen reader announcement on nav expand; 4) long-name truncation accessible name.

design-bot: Reminder: create doc "nav-share-pattern" in design folder and tag eng + a11y. (reaction: :bell:)

anya: next steps: olivia will write exact breadcrumb copy and tooltip text; mike will draft the redirect table + nav map; jamal will write the history rules; ada-a11y will review aria language; sam will add analytics events. I'll update the Figma and link tickets here.
